name: Hiring Philosophy
research_question: Which companies publicly describe hiring for ownership, learning speed and high-agency behaviour?

sources.rationale: Direct statements about who the company hires and how it evaluates candidates.
First-party evidence about expected behaviours and working norms.
Repeated candidate expectations can reveal the practical hiring philosophy.

signals.name: Ownership
signals.query: people take ownership and act with autonomy

signals.name: Learning speed
signals.query: curious people learn quickly and adapt

signals.name: High agency
signals.query: builders act without waiting for permission
